e: Borrowed from Russian отход (otxod, “withdrawal, departure, break”).
q: Thanks to the widespread otkhod from peasant villages, especially in construction, and Soviet managers' propensity to "storm," industrial life was not an entirely alien world to the Soviet Union's peasants.
